raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Alliance Bernstein India – Senior Analyst
Jan’2023 – May’2026
Derivative Operations (Trade Settlement)
Area of Handled
Executed pre- and post-settlement of OTC derivative trades including Interest Rate Swaps (IRS), Forwards, and Credit Default Swaps (CDS), ensuring timely and accurate processing.
Matched and validated trade economics against confirmations to ensure settlement readiness. • Performed cash flow validation and processed settlement payments, ensuring correct value

dates, currencies, and counterparty instructions Investigated and resolved settlement breaks through detailed reconciliation of trade data, cash flows, and counterparty records.
Reconciled trades and cash movements in internal systems (CTC) to ensure alignment with custodian and counterparty records.
Verified SWIFT payment details and coordinated with custodians and counterparties to resolve payment and settlement exceptions.
Verified SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) and ensured accurate routing of payments via custody platforms (JPM Portal, MYSS, BBH).
Coordinated with custodians and counterparties to resolve settlement mismatches and payment discrepancies.
Utilized Bloomberg Terminal to validate market data impacting settlement amounts (Rates, FX,

Corporate actions). Identified root causes of recurring settlement issues and contributed to process improvements to reduce trade breaks and settlement delays.
Generated daily settlement reports highlighting failed trades, pending payments, and exception items for tracking and escalation.
Team handling for New Joiners to raise the access and guide them for process overview and trainings.
AXA Business Pvt Ltd - Specialist
March’2022 – Dec’2022
Derivative Operations (OTC Trade Settlement and reconciliation)
Ensured departmental standard and deadlines are consistently met. • Research and resolution of contract discrepancies (price, product, date, etc.) • Ensured that all DTC eligible trades are settled on contractual settlement date. • Communicated problems to the business lines and ensured proper escalation. • Ensure resolution of all operational issues with custodians, banks, and brokers. • Resolve aged issues and breaks by acting as an escalation point between broker and custodian.
State Street HCL Services Pvt Ltd
Feb’2020 – March’2022
Transfer Agency & Fund Operations – Senior Analyst
Responsibilities:
Managed end-to-end fund operations, including Fund Accounting, Transfer Agency, NAV calculation, reconciliation, investor servicing, and transaction processing.
Prepared and distributed investor reports, including Transaction History, Accrual Reports and capital activity statements.
Calculated and processed investor allocations for capital calls, distributions, equalizations and other fund-related transactions.
Managed Drop and Post report processing through the GUI application to ensure accurate fund transaction processing.
Executed wire transfers for capital stock transactions, including subscription and redemption of investment funds.
Maintained fund master data by processing Add, Modify, and Delete requests for new and existing funds using Fund Connect, Cash Sweep, and GUI applications.
Supported fund accounting activities by monitoring new fund setups, balance sheet exceptions, oversell positions, and rebate processing.
Partnered with the Investor Relations team to respond to investor inquiries and communicate capital activities, fund notices, and transaction updates.
Ensured compliance with internal controls, operational procedures, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) while maintaining high-quality client service
Application Used
Computer literate with Knowledge of MS Word, Excel, Power point, Power BI. • Operating system: MS office, MS excel • Multi-Currency horizon (MCH), Bloomberg, Fund Connect, GUI, CTC, AB Advantage, Calypso ACE, MS Access MS metrics.
